argo-service.yaml
values.yaml

# Complete Foxy Fabrications Deployment
# This file deploys both the main site and admin site with shared product image storage
# Run: kubectl apply -f production.yaml
# Namespace for main site
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-production
---
# =================== 1PASSWORD SECRETS ===================
# Sync hCaptcha credentials from 1Password
apiVersion: onepassword.com/v1
kind: OnePasswordItem
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-hcaptcha
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  itemPath: "vaults/kubernetes/items/hcaptcha-foxy-fabrications"
---
# Sync SumUp credentials from 1Password
apiVersion: onepassword.com/v1
kind: OnePasswordItem
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-production
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  itemPath: "vaults/kubernetes/items/sumup-foxy-fabrications"
---
# Sync gmail credentials from 1Password
apiVersion: onepassword.com/v1
kind: OnePasswordItem
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-email
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  itemPath: "vaults/kubernetes/items/foxy-fabrications-email"
---
# =================== DOCKER REGISTRY SECRETS ===================
# Job to create Docker registry secrets from 1Password-synced credentials
# This runs automatically when you apply this file
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: create-docker-secrets
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
  annotations:
    helm.sh/hook: pre-install,pre-upgrade
    helm.sh/hook-delete-policy: before-hook-creation
spec:
  ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 100
  template:
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: docker-secret-creator
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
      containers:
        - name: create-secrets
          image: bitnami/kubectl:latest
          command:
            - /bin/bash
            - -c
            - |
              set -e
              echo "Creating Docker registry secrets from 1Password credentials..."

              # Wait for 1Password secret to be available
              for i in {1..30}; do
                if kubectl get secret ghcr-foxy-fabrications -n foxy-fabrications-production &>/dev/null; then
                  echo "Found 1Password secret"
                  break
                fi
                echo "Waiting for 1Password secret... ($i/30)"
                sleep 2
              done

              # Get credentials
              USERNAME=$(kubectl get secret ghcr-foxy-fabrications -n foxy-fabrications-production -o jsonpath='{.data.username}' | base64 -d)
              PASSWORD=$(kubectl get secret ghcr-foxy-fabrications -n foxy-fabrications-production -o jsonpath='{.data.password}' | base64 -d)
              EMAIL=$(kubectl get secret ghcr-foxy-fabrications -n foxy-fabrications-production -o jsonpath='{.data.email}' | base64 -d)

              # Create docker secrets
              kubectl create secret docker-registry github-registry-secret \
                --docker-server=ghcr.io \
                --docker-username="$USERNAME" \
                --docker-password="$PASSWORD" \
                --docker-email="$EMAIL" \
                --namespace=foxy-fabrications-production \
                --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

              kubectl create secret docker-registry github-registry-secret-admin \
                --docker-server=ghcr.io \
                --docker-username="$USERNAME" \
                --docker-password="$PASSWORD" \
                --docker-email="$EMAIL" \
                --namespace=foxy-fabrications-production \
                --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -

              echo "Docker registry secrets created successfully!"
---
# ServiceAccount for the Job
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: docker-secret-creator
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
---
# Role to allow reading 1Password secrets and creating docker secrets
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: docker-secret-creator
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["secrets"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "create", "update", "patch"]
---
# RoleBinding
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: docker-secret-creator
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: docker-secret-creator
    namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: docker-secret-creator
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
---
# =================== SHARED STORAGE ===================
# Single shared PVC using NFS storage class with ReadWriteMany
# Both main site and admin site will mount this same PVC
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-shared-images
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
  annotations:
    storageClassName: "nfs"
spec:
  storageClassName: nfs
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteMany # This allows multiple pods to mount the same PVC
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Gi
---
# Gallery images PVC using NFS storage class with ReadWriteMany
# Both main site and admin site will mount this for gallery management
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-gallery-images
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
  annotations:
    storageClassName: "nfs"
spec:
  storageClassName: nfs
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteMany # This allows multiple pods to mount the same PVC
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 5Gi
---
# =================== CERTIFICATES ===================
# Let's Encrypt certificate for main site
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-tls-cert
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  secretName: foxy-fabrications-tls-secret
  issuerRef:
    name: letsencrypt-production-dns
    kind: ClusterIssuer
  dnsNames:
    - foxyfabrications.co.uk
    - www.foxyfabrications.co.uk
  commonName: foxyfabrications.co.uk
---
# Let's Encrypt certificate for admin site
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-admin-tls-cert
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  secretName: foxy-fabrications-admin-tls-secret
  issuerRef:
    name: letsencrypt-production-dns
    kind: ClusterIssuer
  dnsNames:
    - admin.foxyfabrications.co.uk
  commonName: admin.foxyfabrications.co.uk
---
# =================== MAIN SITE SERVICES ===================
# HTTPS Service for main site (TLS termination point)
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-https
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
  annotations:
    traefik.ingress.kubernetes.io/service.nodeportlb: "true"
spec:
  type: NodePort
  ports:
    - port: 443
      targetPort: 443
      nodePort: 30453
      name: https
  selector:
    app: foxy-fabrications
---
# Headless service for main site
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-node-endpoint
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  clusterIP: None
  ports:
    - port: 30453
      targetPort: 30453
      name: https
---
# Manual endpoint slice for main site
apiVersion: discovery.k8s.io/v1
kind: EndpointSlice
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-node-endpoint
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
  labels:
    kubernetes.io/service-name: foxy-fabrications-node-endpoint
addressType: IPv4
endpoints:
  - addresses:
      - "192.168.1.20" # Node 1 IP
    conditions:
      ready: true
  - addresses:
      - "192.168.1.21" # Node 2 IP
    conditions:
      ready: true
ports:
  - name: https
    port: 30453
    protocol: TCP
---
# =================== ADMIN SITE SERVICES ===================
# HTTPS Service for admin site (TLS termination point)
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-admin-https
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
  annotations:
    traefik.ingress.kubernetes.io/service.nodeportlb: "true"
spec:
  type: NodePort
  ports:
    - port: 443
      targetPort: 443
      nodePort: 30454 # Different port from main site
      name: https
  selector:
    app: foxy-fabrications-admin
---
# Headless service for admin site
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-admin-node-endpoint
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  clusterIP: None
  ports:
    - port: 30454
      targetPort: 30454
      name: https
---
# Manual endpoint slice for admin site
apiVersion: discovery.k8s.io/v1
kind: EndpointSlice
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-admin-node-endpoint
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
  labels:
    kubernetes.io/service-name: foxy-fabrications-admin-node-endpoint
addressType: IPv4
endpoints:
  - addresses:
      - "192.168.1.20" # Node 1 IP
    conditions:
      ready: true
  - addresses:
      - "192.168.1.21" # Node 2 IP
    conditions:
      ready: true
ports:
  - name: https
    port: 30454
    protocol: TCP
---
# =================== INGRESS ROUTES & MIDDLEWARE ===================
# HTTP IngressRoute for www redirect
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: IngressRoute
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-www-redirect
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  entryPoints:
    - web
  routes:
    - match: Host(`www.foxyfabrications.co.uk`)
      kind: Rule
      middlewares:
        - name: www-to-non-www
      services:
        - name: foxy-fabrications-https
          port: 443
---
# HTTP IngressRoute for main site (redirect to HTTPS)
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: IngressRoute
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-http-redirect
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  entryPoints:
    - web
  routes:
    - match: Host(`foxyfabrications.co.uk`)
      kind: Rule
      middlewares:
        # Temporarily disabled lan-only for SumUp testing
        # - name: lan-only
        - name: https-redirect
      services:
        - name: foxy-fabrications-https
          port: 443
---
# HTTP IngressRoute for admin site (redirect to HTTPS)
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: IngressRoute
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-admin-http-redirect
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  entryPoints:
    - web
  routes:
    - match: Host(`admin.foxyfabrications.co.uk`)
      kind: Rule
      middlewares:
        - name: lan-only
        - name: https-redirect
      services:
        - name: foxy-fabrications-admin-https
          port: 443
---
# TCP IngressRoute for www (TLS passthrough to redirect)
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: IngressRouteTCP
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-www-tcp
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  entryPoints:
    - websecure
  routes:
    - match: HostSNI(`www.foxyfabrications.co.uk`)
      services:
        - name: foxy-fabrications-node-endpoint
          port: 30453
  tls:
    passthrough: true
---
# TCP IngressRoute for main site (TLS passthrough)
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: IngressRouteTCP
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-tcp
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  entryPoints:
    - websecure
  routes:
    - match: HostSNI(`foxyfabrications.co.uk`)
      services:
        - name: foxy-fabrications-node-endpoint
          port: 30453
      middlewares:
      # Temporarily disabled lan-only-tcp for SumUp testing
      # - name: lan-only-tcp
  tls:
    passthrough: true
---
# TCP IngressRoute for admin site (TLS passthrough)
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: IngressRouteTCP
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications-admin-tcp
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  entryPoints:
    - websecure
  routes:
    - match: HostSNI(`admin.foxyfabrications.co.uk`)
      services:
        - name: foxy-fabrications-admin-node-endpoint
          port: 30454
      middlewares:
        - name: lan-only-tcp
  tls:
    passthrough: true
---
# WWW to non-WWW redirect middleware
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: Middleware
metadata:
  name: www-to-non-www
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  redirectRegex:
    regex: ^https?://www\.foxyfabrications\.co\.uk/(.*)
    replacement: https://foxyfabrications.co.uk/${1}
    permanent: true
---
# HTTPS redirect middleware (main site)
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: Middleware
metadata:
  name: https-redirect
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  redirectScheme:
    scheme: https
    permanent: true
---
# HTTPS redirect middleware (admin site)
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: Middleware
metadata:
  name: https-redirect
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  redirectScheme:
    scheme: https
    permanent: true
---
# HTTP Middleware for IP whitelisting (main site)
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: Middleware
metadata:
  name: lan-only
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  ipWhiteList:
    sourceRange:
      - "192.168.1.0/24"
      - "127.0.0.1/32"
      - "::1/128"
---
# HTTP Middleware for IP whitelisting (admin site)
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: Middleware
metadata:
  name: lan-only
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  ipWhiteList:
    sourceRange:
      - "192.168.1.0/24"
      - "127.0.0.1/32"
      - "::1/128"
---
# TCP Middleware for IP whitelisting (main site)
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: MiddlewareTCP
metadata:
  name: lan-only-tcp
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  ipWhiteList:
    sourceRange:
      - "192.168.1.0/24"
      - "127.0.0.1/32"
      - "::1/128"
---
# TCP Middleware for IP whitelisting (admin site)
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: MiddlewareTCP
metadata:
  name: lan-only-tcp
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
spec:
  ipWhiteList:
    sourceRange:
      - "192.168.1.0/24"
      - "127.0.0.1/32"
      - "::1/128"
---
# =================== NGINX CONFIG MAPS ===================
# Nginx configuration for main site TLS termination
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: nginx-tls-config
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
data:
  nginx.conf: "events {\n    worker_connections 1024;\n}\nhttp {\n    # Remove all upload size limits to let application handle it\n    client_max_body_size 0;\n    \n    # Global timeout settings for large uploads\n    proxy_connect_timeout 300s;\n    proxy_send_timeout 300s;\n    proxy_read_timeout 300s;\n    send_timeout 300s;\n    \n    upstream app {\n        server localhost:3000;\n    }\n    server {\n        listen 443 ssl http2;\n        server_name foxyfabrications.co.uk;\n        \n        # Remove upload size limit at server level too\n        client_max_body_size 0;\n        \n        # SSL Certificate from cert-manager\n        ssl_certificate /etc/ssl/certs/tls.crt;\n        ssl_certificate_key /etc/ssl/certs/tls.key;\n        ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;\n        ssl_ciphers ECDHE+AESGCM:ECDHE+CHACHA20:DHE+AESGCM:DHE+CHACHA20:!aNULL:!MD5:!DSS;\n        ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;\n        \n        # Security headers\n        add_header Strict-Transport-Security \"max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains\" always;\n        add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff always;\n        \n        # CSP is handled by the application to avoid conflicts\n        \n        # Serve gallery images via product-images/gallery/ path\n        location /product-images/gallery/ {\n            alias /var/www/gallery-images/;\n            expires 1y;\n            add_header Cache-Control \"public, immutable\";\n            access_log off;\n        }\n        \n        # Serve static product images directly\n        location /product-images/ {\n            alias /var/www/product-images/;\n            expires 1y;\n            add_header Cache-Control \"public, immutable\";\n            access_log off;\n        }\n        \n        # Proxy all other requests to the Node.js app\n        location / {\n            # Remove upload size limit at location level as well\n            client_max_body_size 0;\n            \n            # Location-specific timeout settings\n            proxy_connect_timeout 300s;\n            proxy_send_timeout 300s;\n            proxy_read_timeout 300s;\n            \n            proxy_pass http://app;\n            proxy_set_header Host $host;\n            proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;\n            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;\n            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;\n            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Host $host;\n            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Port $server_port;\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
---
# Nginx configuration for admin site TLS termination
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: nginx-tls-config-admin
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
data:
  nginx.conf: "events {\n    worker_connections 1024;\n}\nhttp {\n    # Remove all upload size limits to let application handle it\n    client_max_body_size 0;\n    \n    # Global timeout settings for large uploads\n    proxy_connect_timeout 300s;\n    proxy_send_timeout 300s;\n    proxy_read_timeout 300s;\n    send_timeout 300s;\n    \n    upstream app {\n        server localhost:3001;\n    }\n    server {\n        listen 443 ssl http2;\n        server_name admin.foxyfabrications.co.uk;\n        \n        # Remove upload size limit at server level too\n        client_max_body_size 0;\n        \n        # SSL Certificate from cert-manager\n        ssl_certificate /etc/ssl/certs/tls.crt;\n        ssl_certificate_key /etc/ssl/certs/tls.key;\n        ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;\n        ssl_ciphers ECDHE+AESGCM:ECDHE+CHACHA20:DHE+AESGCM:DHE+CHACHA20:!aNULL:!MD5:!DSS;\n        ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;\n        \n        # Security headers\n        add_header Strict-Transport-Security \"max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains\" always;\n        add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff always;\n        \n        # CSP is handled by the application to avoid conflicts\n        \n        # Serve static product images directly\n        location /product-images/ {\n            alias /var/www/product-images/;\n            expires 1y;\n            add_header Cache-Control \"public, immutable\";\n            access_log off;\n        }\n        \n        # Serve static gallery images directly\n        location /product-images/gallery/ {\n            alias /var/www/gallery-images/;\n            expires 1y;\n            add_header Cache-Control \"public, immutable\";\n            access_log off;\n        }\n        \n        # Proxy all other requests to the Node.js app\n        location / {\n            # Remove upload size limit at location level as well\n            client_max_body_size 0;\n            \n            # Location-specific timeout settings\n            proxy_connect_timeout 300s;\n            proxy_send_timeout 300s;\n            proxy_read_timeout 300s;\n            \n            proxy_pass http://app;\n            proxy_set_header Host $host;\n            proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;\n            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;\n            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;\n            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Host $host;\n            proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Port $server_port;\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
---
# =================== DEPLOYMENTS ===================
# Main site deployment with app and TLS sidecar
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: foxy-fabrications
  namespace: foxy-fabrications-production
  labels:
    app: foxy-fabrications
  annotations:
    reloader.stakater.com/auto: "true"
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: foxy-fabrications
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: foxy-fabrications
    spec:
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: github-registry-secret
      containers:
        # Foxy-fabrications main application
        - name: foxy-fabrications
          image: ghcr.io/grimvoodoo/foxy-fabrications:v1.3.4
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 256Mi
          ports:
            - containerPort: 3000
              name: http
          volumeMounts:
            - name: shared-product-images
              mountPath: /product-images
              readOnly: false # Read-write access for serving images
            - name: shared-gallery-images
              mountPath: /gallery-images
              readOnly: true # Read-only access for serving gallery images
          env:
            - name: MONGODB_USERNAME
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: mongodb-prod
                  key: username
            - name: MONGODB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: mongodb-prod
                  key: password
            - name: MONGODB_URI
              value: "mongodb://$(MONGODB_USERNAME):$(MONGODB_PASSWORD)@192.168.1.31:27017/"
            - name: GALLERY_DIR
              value: "/gallery-images"
            - name: SUMUP_API_URL
              value: "https://api.sumup.com"
            - name: SUMUP_ACCESS_TOKEN
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: foxy-fabrications-production
                  key: ACCESS_TOKEN
            - name: SUMUP_OAUTH2_SECRET
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: foxy-fabrications-production
                  key: OAUTH2_SECRET
            - name: SUMUP_MERCHANT_CODE
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: foxy-fabrications-production
                  key: MERCHANT_CODE
            - name: SUMUP_CURRENCY
              value: "GBP"
            - name: SUMUP_RETURN_URL
              value: "https://foxyfabrications.co.uk/checkout/success"
            - name: SUMUP_WEBHOOK_URL
              value: "https://foxyfabrications.co.uk/checkout/webhook"
            - name: SUMUP_EMAIL
              value: "info.foxyfabrications@gmail.com"
            - name: FORCE_HTTPS
              value: "true"
            - name: GMAIL_USERNAME
              value: "info.foxyfabrications@gmail.com"
            - name: GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: foxy-fabrications-email
                  key: PASSWORD
            - name: CLAMAV_URL
              value: "http://clamav-rest-api.default.svc.cluster.local:8080"
            - name: VIRUS_SCAN_ENABLED
              value: "true"
            - name: ENVIRONMENT
              value: "production"
            - name: HCAPTCHA_SITE_KEY
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: foxy-fabrications-hcaptcha
                  key: HCAPTCHA_SITE_KEY
            - name: HCAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: foxy-fabrications-hcaptcha
                  key: HCAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY
        # Nginx TLS termination sidecar
        - name: nginx-tls
          image: nginx:alpine
          ports:
            - containerPort: 443
              name: https
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            requests:
              cpu: 50m
              memory: 64Mi
          volumeMounts:
            - name: nginx-config
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
              subPath: nginx.conf
            - name: tls-certs
              mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs
              readOnly: true
            - name: shared-product-images
              mountPath: /var/www/product-images
              readOnly: true
            - name: shared-gallery-images
              mountPath: /var/www/gallery-images
              readOnly: true
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 443
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 443
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
